( 54K . Win7 )

|00 @System/vector $2 &expansion $2 &wst $1 &rst $1 &metadata $2 &r $2 &g $2 &b $2 &debug $1 &state $1
|10 @Console/vector $2 &read $5 &type $1 &write $1 &error $1
|20 @Screen/vector $2 &width $2 &height $2 &auto $1 &pad $1 &x $2 &y $2 &addr $2 &pixel $1 &sprite $1
|80 @Controller/vector $2 &button $1 &key $1
|90 @Mouse/vector $2 &x $2 &y $2 &state $1 &pad $3 &sx $2 &sy $1 &sy-lb $1
|a0 @File/vector $2 &success $1 &success-lb $1 &stat $2 &delete $1 &append $1 &name $2 &length $2 &read $2 &write $2

(
@|Enums )

|004f @Varvara/version
|0200 @WIDTH
|00c0 @header/rows
|0100 @header/center
|2000 @path/dirlen
|2000 @directory/len
|0018 @directory/x1pad
|002a @directory/y1
|0034 @directory/y1pad
|0005 @directory/cols
|002a @scroll/y1
|0060 @file/width
|0038 @file/height

|000

	@path/buf $2 &null $80
	@directory/sel $2

|100

@on-reset ( -> )
	;meta #06 DEO2
	theme/<load>
	;dict/home-path path/<set>
	;WIDTH #0120 window/<set-size>
	path/<refresh>
	<redraw-all>
	header/<bind>
	directory/<bind>
	BRK

@meta $1
	( ) "Win7 0a
	( ) "A 20 "windowing 20 "interface 0a
	( ) "By 20 "Devine 20 "Lu 20 "Linvega 0a
	( ) "21 20 "Aug 20 "2026 00
	( 2 ) 02
	( - ) 56 =Varvara/version
	( - ) a0 =manifest/dat

@manifest/dat ( . )
	_{ =dict/win7
	( - ) 21 00 =directory/<open> =dict/next
	( - ) 10 00 =directory/<prev-row> =dict/prev-row
	( - ) 20 00 =directory/<next-row> =dict/next-row
	( - ) 40 00 =directory/<prev> =dict/prev
	( - ) 80 00 =directory/<next> =dict/next
	( - ) 00 08 =directory/<parent> =dict/parent
	( - ) 00 1b =directory/<deselect> =dict/deselect }
	( ) $1

%Screen/<set-pos> ( x* y* -- ) {
	.Screen/y DEO2
	.Screen/x DEO2 }

%u16/mod2 ( x* div* -- res* ) {
	DIV2k MUL2 SUB2 }

@<redraw-all> ( -- )
	header/<draw>
	directory/<redraw>
	status/<redraw> !scroll/<redraw>

@<draw-times-addr> ( color times addr* auto -- )
	.Screen/auto DEO
	,&addr STR2
	SWP STH
	[ LITr -Screen/sprite ]
	&>l
		[ LIT2 &addr $2 ] .Screen/addr DEO2
		DEOkr
		INC DUP ?/>l
	POP POP2r JMP2r

@cursor/<refocus> ( -- )
	.Mouse/y DEI2 DUP2 #0013 LTH2 ?{ #002a LTH2 ?{ !directory/<bind> }
		!status/<bind> }
	POP2 !header/<bind>

(
@|Path )

@path/<set> ( path* -- )
	[ LIT2 -&buf _&ptr ] STR
	( >> )

@path/<push-str> ( subpath* -- )
	&>wpu
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		[ LIT2 00 &ptr -&buf ] INCk ,&ptr STR
		STZ2
		INC2 !/>wpu

@path/pop ( -- )
	/nest INC #00 OVR STZ
	,&ptr STR
	JMP2r

@path/get-location ( -- str* )
	#00
	( >> )

@path/nest ( -- addr )
	[ LIT2 -&buf _&ptr ] LDR #01 SUB
	&>rew
		#01 SUB LDZk [ LIT "/ ] EQU ?{ NEQk ?/>rew }
	NIP JMP2r

@path/<refresh> ( -- )
	;&buf .File/name DEO2
	;&dirlen .File/length DEO2
	;&dirbuf .File/read DEO2
	/<nullws>
	/<parse-folders>
	/<parse-files>
	header/<draw>
	directory/<redraw>
	scroll/<redraw>
	status/<redraw>
	JMP2r

@path/<parse-folders> ( -- )
	;&dirbuf
	&>wfo
		LDAk ?{ POP2 JMP2r }
		LDAk LIT "- NEQ ?{ directory/push }
		#0005 ADD2 str/cap INC2 !/>wfo

@path/<parse-files> ( -- )
	;&dirbuf
	&>wfi
		LDAk ?{ POP2 JMP2r }
		LDAk LIT "- EQU ?{ directory/push }
		#0005 ADD2 str/cap INC2 !/>wfi

@path/<nullws> ( -- )
	;&dirbuf
	&>wnw
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		#1f GTH ?{ LITr 00 STH2k STAr }
		INC2 !/>wnw

@path/<print> ( -- )
	;&buf !str/<print>

(
@|Status )

@status/<bind> ( -- )
	;&on-mouse .Mouse/vector DEO2
	JMP2r

@status/on-mouse ( -> )
	cursor/<update>
	BRK

@status/<redraw> ( -- )
	#0000 .Screen/x DEO2
	#0012 .Screen/y DEO2
	[ LIT2 01 -header/rows ] ;&bar-icn #25 <draw-times-addr>
	( | left )
	#0009 #0016 Screen/<set-pos>
	;&a #01 sans/<draw-left-color>
	( | center )
	window/get-center #0016 Screen/<set-pos>
	decstr/<reset>
	directory/get-length decstr/<push-num>
	;&b decstr/<push-str>
	;decstr/buf sans/<draw-center>
	( | right )
	directory/get-sel #ffff NEQ2 ?{ JMP2r }
	window/get-width #0009 SUB2 #0016 Screen/<set-pos>
	;&c sans/<draw-right>
	JMP2r

	&a "Home 00
	&b 20 "Files 00
	&c "1 20 "Selected 00

@status/bar-icn [8
	0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000
	0000 0000 00ff 00ff ]

(
@|Directory )

@directory/<bind> ( -- )
	;&on-button .Controller/vector DEO2
	;&on-mouse .Mouse/vector DEO2
	JMP2r

@directory/on-button ( -> )
	.Controller/button DEI2 DUP2 manifest/scan INC2k ORA ?{ POP2 POP2 BRK }
	( * ) JSR2 POP2 BRK

@directory/on-mouse ( -> )
	cursor/<update>
	( | get id )
	[ LIT2 &last $1 -Mouse/state ] DEI DUP ,&last STR
	DUP2 #0001 EQU2 ?/on-mouse-touch
	DUP2 #0002 EQU2 ?/on-mouse-click
	POP2
	( | Touch )
	BRK

@directory/on-mouse-touch ( last state -> )
	POP2 .Mouse/x DEI2 .Mouse/y DEI2 file/pos-id /<select>
	BRK

@directory/on-mouse-click ( last state -> )
	POP2 .Mouse/x DEI2 .Mouse/y DEI2 file/pos-id /<select>
	/<open>
	BRK

@directory/<deselect> ( -- )
	#ffff !/<set>

@directory/<next> ( -- )
	.&sel LDZ2 INC2 !/<select>

@directory/<next-row> ( -- )
	.&sel LDZ2 ;&cols ADD2 !/<select>

@directory/<prev> ( -- )
	.&sel LDZ2 #0001 SUB2 !/<select>

@directory/<prev-row> ( -- )
	.&sel LDZ2 ;&cols SUB2 !/<select>

@directory/<select> ( id* -- )
	OVR #80 AND ?/<select-first>
	/get-length LTH2k ?{ #0001 SUB2 SWP2 }
	POP2
	( >> )

@directory/<set> ( id* -- )
	.&sel STZ2
	status/<redraw>
	/<redraw> !scroll/<redraw>

@directory/<select-first> ( id* -- )
	POP2 #0000 !/<set>

@directory/push ( desc-name* -- desc-name* )
	DUP2 #0005 ADD2 [ LIT2 &ptr =&buf ] INC2k INC2 ,&ptr STR2
	STA2
	JMP2r

@directory/get-length ( -- length* )
	,&ptr LDR2 ;&buf SUB2 #01 SFT2 JMP2r

@directory/get-sel ( -- id* )
	.&sel LDZ2 JMP2r

@directory/<redraw> ( -- )
	( | Clear )
	#0000 ;&y1 Screen/<set-pos>
	[ LIT2 80 -Screen/pixel ] DEO
	( | Draw )
	[ LIT2r 0000 ] ,&ptr LDR2 ;&buf
	&>l
		LDA2k STH2kr file/<draw>
		INC2 INC2 INC2r GTH2k ?/>l
	POP2 POP2 POP2r JMP2r

@directory/<open> ( -- )
	/get-selection file/is-folder ?{ path/<print> !str/<print-ln> }
	path/<push-str>
	( | enter folder )
	/<reset>
	/<deselect> !path/<refresh>

@directory/<parent> ( -- )
	/<reset>
	/<deselect>
	path/pop path/<refresh>
	JMP2r

@directory/<reset> ( -- )
	;&buf ,&ptr STR2
	#0000 ;&buf STA2
	JMP2r

@directory/get-selection ( -- addr* )
	.&sel LDZ2 DUP2 ADD2 ;&buf ADD2 LDA2 JMP2r

(
@|File )

@file/<draw> ( name* id* -- )
	DUP2 /id-pos Screen/<set-pos>
	OVR2 /<draw-icon>
	/get-color !sans/<draw-center-color>

@file/get-color ( id* -- color )
	.directory/sel LDZ2 EQU2 ?{ #01 JMP2r }
	#09 JMP2r

@file/<position> ( id* -- )
	DUP2 ;directory/cols u16/mod2 #60 SFT2 #0010 ADD2 .Screen/x DEO2
	;directory/cols DIV2 #60 SFT2 #0030 ADD2 .Screen/y DEO2
	JMP2r

@file/<draw-icon> ( name* -- )
	[ LIT2 36 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	/get-sprite .Screen/addr DEO2
	#05 .Screen/sprite DEOk DEOk DEOk DEO
	.Screen/x DEI2k #0010 ADD2 ROT DEO2
	JMP2r

@file/get-sprite ( name* -- sprite* )
	/is-folder ?/get-folder
	/is-data ?/get-data
	/is-rom ?/get-rom
	/is-pict ?/get-pict
	POP2 ;&unknown JMP2r

@file/is-folder ( name* -- name* t )
	DUP2 str/cap #0001 SUB2 LDA LIT "/ EQU JMP2r

@file/is-rom ( name* -- name* t )
	DUP2 str/cap #0004 SUB2 ;dict/rom-ext str/cmp JMP2r

@file/is-chr ( name* -- name* t )
	DUP2 str/cap #0004 SUB2 ;dict/chr-ext str/cmp JMP2r

@file/is-icn ( name* -- name* t )
	DUP2 str/cap #0004 SUB2 ;dict/icn-ext str/cmp JMP2r

@file/is-uf2 ( name* -- name* t )
	DUP2 str/cap #0004 SUB2 ;dict/uf2-ext str/cmp JMP2r

@file/is-pict ( name* -- name* t )
	/is-icn ?{ /is-chr ?{ !/is-uf2 } }
	#01 JMP2r

@file/is-data ( name* -- name* t )
	DUP2 str/cap #0004 SUB2 LDA LIT ". NEQ JMP2r

@file/get-folder ( name* -- sprite* )
	POP2 ;&folder JMP2r

@file/get-data ( name* -- sprite* )
	POP2 ;&text JMP2r

@file/get-rom ( name* -- sprite* )
	POP2 ;&rom JMP2r

@file/get-pict ( name* -- sprite* )
	POP2 ;&pict JMP2r

@file/id-pos ( id* -- x* y* )
	( x ) DUP2 ;directory/cols u16/mod2 ;&width MUL2 ;directory/x1pad ADD2
	( y ) SWP2 ;directory/cols DIV2 ;&height MUL2 ;directory/y1pad ADD2 JMP2r

@file/pos-id ( x* y* -- id* )
	( y ) ;directory/y1pad SUB2 ;&height DIV2 ;directory/cols MUL2
	( x ) SWP2 ;&width DIV2 ;directory/cols u16/mod2 ADD2 JMP2r

(
@|Scroll )

@scroll/<redraw> ( -- )
	window/get-width #0010 SUB2 ;&y1 Screen/<set-pos>
	[ LIT2 01 d5 ] ;&bg-icn #16 <draw-times-addr>
	( | top )
	;&y1 .Screen/y DEO2
	;&arrow-icn .Screen/addr DEO2
	#01 .Screen/sprite DEOk DEO
	( | middle )
	#0039 .Screen/y DEO2
	;&drag-chr .Screen/addr DEO2
	#85 .Screen/sprite DEOk DEO
	( | bottom )
	.Screen/height DEI2 #0008 SUB2 .Screen/y DEO2
	;&arrow-icn .Screen/addr DEO2
	#21 .Screen/sprite DEOk DEO
	JMP2r

(
@|DecStr )

@decstr/<reset> ( -- )
	;&buf ,&ptr STR2
	#0000 ;&buf STA2
	JMP2r

@decstr/<push-str> ( num* -- )
	&>w
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		/<push>
		INC2 !/>w

@decstr/<push-num> ( short* -- )
	[ LIT2r ff00 ]
	&>read
		#000a DIV2k STH2k MUL2 SUB2 STH2r INCr ORAk ?/>read
	POP2
	&>write
		NIP #30 ADD /<push>
		OVRr ADDr STHkr ?/>write
	POP2r JMP2r

@decstr/<push> ( c -- )
	#00 [ LIT2 &ptr =&buf ] INC2k ,&ptr STR2
	STA2
	JMP2r

(
@|Stdlib )

@str/<print-ln> ( str* -- )
	/<print>
	#0a18 DEO
	JMP2r

@str/<print> ( str* -- )
	LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
	#18 DEO
	INC2 !/<print>

@str/cap ( str* -- end* )
	LDAk ?{ JMP2r }
	INC2 !/cap

@str/cmp ( a* b* -- f )
	STH2
	&>wc
		LDAk ?{ &d LDA LDAr STHr EQU JMP2r }
		LDAk LDAkr STHr NEQ ?/d
		INC2 INC2r !/>wc

(
@|Dict )

@dict/win7 "Win7 00
	&next "Next 00
	&prev "Previous 00
	&next-row "Next 20 "Row 00
	&prev-row "Previous 20 "Row 00
	&parent "Parent 00
	&deselect "Deselect 00
	&chr-ext ".chr 00
	&icn-ext ".icn 00
	&uf2-ext ".uf2 00
	&rom-ext ".rom 00
	&home-path "./ 00



( Utils )
(
@|Cursor )

@cursor/<update> ( -- )
	[ LIT2 12 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	#40 ;fill-icn /<draw>
	[ LIT2 16 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	#c1 ;&down-chr .Mouse/state DEI ?{ POP2 ;&up-chr }
	.Mouse/x DEI2 ,&x STR2
	.Mouse/y DEI2 ,&y STR2
	/<refocus>
	( >> )

@cursor/<draw> ( color addr* -- )
	.Screen/addr DEO2
	[ LIT2 &x $2 ] #0004 SUB2 .Screen/x DEO2
	[ LIT2 &y $2 ] #0004 SUB2 .Screen/y DEO2
	.Screen/sprite DEOk DEO
	JMP2r

(
@|Header )

@header/<bind> ( -- )
	;&on-mouse .Mouse/vector DEO2
	JMP2r

@header/on-mouse ( -> )
	cursor/<update>
	[ LIT2 &last $1 -Mouse/state ] DEI
	( | handlers )
	DUP2 #0002 NEQ2 ?{ window/toggle-shade }
	DUP2 #0001 NEQ2 ?{ /outside-quit ?{ /<press-quit> } }
	DUP2 #0100 NEQ2 ?{ /<release-quit> }
	,&last STR
	POP BRK

@header/outside-quit ( -- f )
	.Mouse/x DEI2 #0008 SUB2 #000c GTH2 ?{
		.Mouse/y DEI2 #0002 SUB2 #000c GTH2 ?{ #00 JMP2r } }
	#01 JMP2r

@header/<press-quit> ( -- )
	#0008 .Screen/x DEO2
	#0000 .Screen/y DEO2
	;&button-down-icn !/<draw-button>

@header/<release-quit> ( -- )
	/outside-quit ?{ #800f DEO }
	( >> )

@header/<draw> ( -- )
	#0000 .Screen/x DEO2
	#0000 .Screen/y DEO2
	[ LIT2 85 -&rows ] ;&bg-chr #25 <draw-times-addr>
	( | 1px right )
	.Screen/x DEI2k #0001 SUB2 ROT DEO2
	#000e .Screen/y DEO2
	[ LIT2 a2 -Screen/pixel ] DEO
	( | button right )
	window/get-width #001a SUB2 .Screen/x DEO2
	#0000 .Screen/y DEO2
	;&collapse-icn /<draw-button>
	( | 1px left )
	#0001 .Screen/x DEO2
	#000e .Screen/y DEO2
	[ LIT2 b2 -Screen/pixel ] DEO
	( | title )
	path/get-location INC2 /<draw-title>
	( | button left )
	#0008 .Screen/x DEO2
	#0000 .Screen/y DEO2
	;&button-icn
	( >> )

@header/<draw-button> ( button* -- )
	.Screen/addr DEO2
	[ LIT2 15 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	[ LIT2 09 -Screen/sprite ] DEOk DEO
	JMP2r

@header/<draw-title> ( str* -- )
	;&center OVR2 chicago/get-str-width #01 SFT2 SUB2
	( ) #000a SUB2 .Screen/x DEO2
	#0001 .Screen/y DEO2
	[ LIT2 15 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	#09 ;chicago/color STA
	#20 chicago/<draw-char>
	#09 chicago/<draw-left-color>
	#20 chicago/<draw-char>
	( | clip )
	.Screen/y DEI2k #0001 SUB2 ROT DEO2
	#81fe ;&bg-chr #15 !<draw-times-addr>

@utf8/next ( addr* -- addr* )
	&>w
		INC2 LDAk #06 SFT #02 EQU ?/>w
	JMP2r

(
@|Window )

@window/get-center ( -- center* )
	/get-width #01 SFT2 JMP2r

@window/get-width ( -- width* )
	[ LIT2 &width $2 ] JMP2r

@window/<set-size> ( width* height* -- )
	DUP2 ,&height STR2
	.Screen/height DEO2
	DUP2 ,&width STR2
	.Screen/width DEO2
	JMP2r

@window/<set-height> ( height* -- )
	DUP2 ,&height STR2
	.Screen/height DEO2
	header/<draw> !<redraw-all>

@window/toggle-shade ( -- )
	#0011 .Screen/height DEI2 EQU2 ?{ #0011 .Screen/height DEO2 !header/<draw> }
	[ LIT2 &height $2 ] .Screen/height DEO2
	header/<draw> !<redraw-all>

@manifest/scan ( but key -- fn* )
	ORAk ?{ POP2 #ffff JMP2r }
	,&bk STR2
	;&dat
	&>cat
		DUP2 LDAk #00 SWP INC ADD2 SWP2 #0003 ADD2
		&>opt
			LDA2k [ LIT2 &bk $2 ] NEQ2 ?{
				NIP2 INC2 INC2 LDA2 JMP2r }
			#0006 ADD2 GTH2k ?/>opt
		POP2 INC2 LDAk ?/>cat
	POP2 #ffff JMP2r

(
@|Theme )

@theme/<reset> ( -- )
	#f0ad #f0ef #f0be
	( >> )

@theme/<set> ( r* g* b* -- )
	.System/b DEO2
	.System/g DEO2
	.System/r DEO2
	JMP2r

@theme/<load> ( -- )
	;&path .File/name DEO2
	#0002 .File/length DEO2
	;&r .File/read DEO2
	;&g .File/read DEO2
	;&b .File/read DEO2
	.File/success-lb DEI ?{ !/<reset> }
	[ LIT2 &r $2 ] [ LIT2 &g $2 ] [ LIT2 &b $2 ] !/<set>

	&path ".theme $1

(
@|Sans10 )

@sans/get-utf8-addr ( addr* -- addr* glyph* )
	LDAk #20 LTH ?{
		LDAk #7f GTH ?{
			LDAk #20 SUB #00 SWP #50 SFT2 ;&glyphs ADD2 JMP2r } }
	;check-icn JMP2r

@sans/get-utf8-width ( addr* -- addr* width* )
	LDAk #7f GTH ?{
		LDAk #20 SUB #0000 ROT ;&widths ADD2 LDA JMP2r }
	#0008 JMP2r

@sans/get-str-width ( text* -- width* )
	[ LIT2r 0000 ]
	&>ww
		/get-utf8-width STH2
		( > ) ADD2r utf8/next LDAk ?/>ww
	POP2 STH2r JMP2r

@sans/<draw-right> ( text* -- )
	.Screen/x DEI2 OVR2 /get-str-width SUB2 .Screen/x DEO2 !/<draw-left>

@sans/<draw-center-color> ( text* color -- )
	,&color STR
	( >> )

@sans/<draw-center> ( text* -- )
	.Screen/x DEI2 OVR2 /get-str-width #01 SFT2 SUB2 .Screen/x DEO2 !/<draw-left>

@sans/<draw-left-color> ( text* color -- )
	,&color STR
	( >> )

@sans/<draw-left> ( text* -- )
	[ LIT2 15 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	&>wsc
		/<draw-utf8>
		utf8/next LDAk ?/>wsc &end POP2 JMP2r

@sans/<draw-utf8> ( addr* -- addr* )
	[ LITr -Screen/x ] DEI2r
	( glyph* ) /get-utf8-addr .Screen/addr DEO2
	( width* ) /get-utf8-width STH2
	( draw2 ) [ LIT2 &color 01 -Screen/sprite ]
	( draw1 ) DUPr [ LITr 08 LTHr JMPr DEOk ] DEO
	ADD2r [ LITr -Screen/x ] DEO2r
	JMP2r

@sans/<draw-char> ( char -- )
	#20 SUB #00 SWP
	( ) DUP2 #50 SFT2 ;&glyphs ADD2 .Screen/addr DEO2
	( ) ;&widths ADD2 LDA #00 SWP .Screen/x DEI2 ADD2
	( ) ,&color LDR .Screen/sprite DEOk DEO
	.Screen/x DEO2
	JMP2r

@sans/<set-color> ( color -- )
	,&color STR
	JMP2r

(
@|Chicago )

@chicago/get-utf8-addr ( addr* -- addr* glyph* )
	LDAk #20 LTH ?{
		LDAk #7f GTH ?{
			LDAk #20 SUB #00 SWP #50 SFT2 ;&glyphs ADD2 JMP2r } }
	;check-icn JMP2r

@chicago/get-utf8-width ( addr* -- addr* width* )
	LDAk #7f GTH ?{
		LDAk #20 SUB #0000 ROT ;&widths ADD2 LDA JMP2r }
	#0008 JMP2r

@chicago/get-str-width ( text* -- width* )
	[ LIT2r 0000 ]
	&>ww
		/get-utf8-width STH2
		( > ) ADD2r utf8/next LDAk ?/>ww
	POP2 STH2r JMP2r

@chicago/<draw-center-color> ( text* color -- )
	STH
	.Screen/x DEI2 OVR2 /get-str-width #01 SFT2 SUB2 .Screen/x DEO2
	STHr !/<draw-left-color>

@chicago/<draw-left-color> ( text* color -- )
	,&color STR
	[ LIT2 15 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	&>wsc
		/<draw-utf8>
		utf8/next LDAk ?/>wsc &end POP2 JMP2r

@chicago/<draw-utf8> ( addr* -- addr* )
	[ LITr -Screen/x ] DEI2r
	( glyph* ) /get-utf8-addr .Screen/addr DEO2
	( width* ) /get-utf8-width STH2
	( draw2 ) [ LIT2 &color 01 -Screen/sprite ]
	( draw1 ) DUPr [ LITr 08 LTHr JMPr DEOk ] DEO
	ADD2r [ LITr -Screen/x ] DEO2r
	JMP2r

@chicago/<draw-char> ( char -- )
	#20 SUB #00 SWP
	( ) DUP2 #50 SFT2 ;&glyphs ADD2 .Screen/addr DEO2
	( ) ;&widths ADD2 LDA #00 SWP .Screen/x DEI2 ADD2
	( ) ,&color LDR .Screen/sprite DEOk DEO
	.Screen/x DEO2
	JMP2r



( Assets )

@check-icn [8
	aa55 aa55 aa55 aa55 aa55 aa55 aa55 aa55 ] $10

@fill-icn [8
	ffff ffff ffff ffff ffff ffff ffff ffff
